outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: base_liveness is the one liveness reading of a base launch (base_running delegates): a recorded pid held by a process started after the write naming it (pidsAt; process_started reads /proc on Linux, ps -o lstart= in the C locale elsewhere, none on Windows) or a wait past boundSeconds (run_bound: red steps x STEP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600, mirroring run-test-gate DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, + FOREGROUND_BOUND_MS/1000, from ranAt) reads the launch cut short; fold_reading keeps the reason as cutBy, cut_short says it, drop_progress releases the claim forced. Nothing is killed. wait-base says waited <age>, cut short at <deadline>, with a bound line carrying the basis (wait_words). The already-ran refusal names what is open (ran_open: measure-base only when the pending decision offers it, else next). R65: stopped_unread counts toward UNMEASURED_BOUND, stoppedBefore beside unmeasuredBefore, carried across measure-base by baseTried (tried_before); measured_reading asks the bound before the unknowable return; bound_said says never measured and by how many tries. R67: ANSWER_SPENDS[(no-executor-return, resume)]=None, answer_spends(answer, decision); rule lines reworded (retry spends an attempt; resume spends no attempt and no round). R90: new_gate_row returns UNREAD when no readable run carries the token and newest_or_unreadable names the subject's record; unread_launch waits naming it to the gate's own bound, then asks gate-cancelled/phase-gate-cancelled. tests: bz-block bz1-bz10, cost reading built from the table's words (_bx_costs/_bx_cost_claims/_bx_rule_reading) failing on an unclassifiable clause, bq4 kill through _run_base_until_measuring/_kill_base, _scripted_liveness stands in for base_liveness, rule-text pins dd3/rs1 updated.
